summary: Use the environment keyword at task or play level to set PATH or other environment variables; at play level the gather_facts setup task also inherits it, so use default to avoid errors.
questions: How do I add a directory to PATH for one task?
Can I set environment variables for the whole play?
Why does gathering facts fail with my play-level environment?

answer_card.title: Set PATH or env vars for a task or play
answer_card.answer_md:
Use **`environment`**:

```yaml
- hosts: servers
  environment:
    PATH: "{{ ansible_env.PATH | default('/usr/bin:/bin') }}:/thingy/bin"
  tasks:
    - shell: date
      environment:
        LANG: fr_FR.UTF-8
```

The fact-gathering task inherits play-level `environment`, and `ansible_env` isn't known yet then, so use `| default`.
